name: Paul Gauguin
findings: Within his own canvases, jasper pink turns up as a small accent in 100% of the paintings that hold it, 3.2x the archive's rate (from 1180 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, hooker's green turns up as the lightest note in 75% of the paintings that hold it, 3.1x the archive's rate (from 1180 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, deep teal green turns up as the shadow in 80% of the paintings that hold it, 2.3x the archive's rate (from 1180 paintings here).
Rarely uses smoky black, common in the same museum(s)' other paintings (from 1180 paintings here).
Rarely uses dark olive brown, common in the same museum(s)' other paintings (from 1180 paintings here).
Pairs old gold with pyrite yellow more than chance would predict (3 of 1180 paintings here).
Pairs bluish grey with cool grey more than chance would predict (3 of 1180 paintings here).
His single largest palette family (dark jungle green, smoky black, white) covers 55% of his paintings here.
